 Newsmax: Fading The Questionable Post-Earnings Rally
 Nov 13, 2026, 4:27 PM ET Newsmax Inc. (NMAX) Stock Vince Martin 7.94K Followers Follow Summary
 Newsmax Inc. looks like a short-duration short opportunity after a post-earnings rally that appears unlikely to hold.
 Q3 adjusted EBITDA of $19 million was inflated by a one-time benefit; the quarter did not materially change NMAX's growth outlook.
 NMAX still needs substantial incremental profit to even support the current valuation, and the path to that growth is uncertain at best.
 With digital struggling, the reliance on linear TV seems to strengthen the bear case; NMAX investors may well realize that soon enough.
